notes.title: Shutter 2 Update
notes.content:
Once again we would like to give a big thank you to everyone who's shown interest in and given their critiques and feedback for Shutter.  Your interest and ideas are really helping us to make a much larger and more ambitious title than the first.

As we're starting to receive more interest and inquiries for the sequel, we wanted to share some screenshots and information with the community to help provide an idea as to how much larger the sequel is actually going to be.  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8287479/17f6de1c4cb246ea79e3979a1f5b08425e3489ed.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8287479/e8d78e4534dc0c8a5b46fe49981258eff6ca391f.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8287479/64046c875f95c0ad8d956f2c37de0e53c1b87f97.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8287479/c55a5c45a0d821e35fc21dffb17971f9e1a76c41.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8287479/79131052b16ba75890e58c1ae873159617b327eb.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8287479/6e75e8c88b4492e8f0dee321981dc7c82fe23fc5.png[/img]

Some things to point out:

- In total, we're looking at about 20+ unique environments to be found, each one of them is close to or larger than the entire original Shutter in size
- A new RC vehicle is going to be used, complete with new abilities and upgrade-able features.
- Game will have more "Survival Horror" elements incorporated as well, and enemy encounters are going to be much more random to keep the player guessing
- Secret areas and stories will also be possible for the player to find.

Some things to note about the screenshots.  As we haven't finished the design for the new RC, you'll notice the original RC being used in some of the shots, this is just something we're using to test the level design as we go, and the original RC won't be used in the final game.  This is also a pre-alpha pass on the graphics,  we plan on incorporating much more detail and interactive objects before final release.  

If images appear dark on some monitors you may have to adjust your brightness.  It's a fairly atmospheric game (i.e flashlight heavy)

Thank you so much again for your support.  And we hope you'll check out the sequel when it's available.

Cosmic Logic

notes.title: Price Drop
notes.content:
We have decided to drop the price of Shutter to $1.99 (USD/CDN) in an effort to gain more exposure as we draw close to revealing the sequel.

We truly appreciate all the support from the community, and it has given us the opportunity to create more ambitious games and learn from our mistakes. We have listened to all your feedback, and we have designed Shutter 2 from the ground up with these considerations in mind.

Please stay tuned for a playable demo and details about our upcoming retro-First-Person-Shooter "Robocalypse Now!"

notes.title: Version 1.11 Ready For Halloween!
notes.content:
We've listened to all your feedback, and we are taking it all into consideration with the development of Shutter 2. We're so excited about the sequel, that we've decided to share some of our early work now.

We've added a new section called "Next Mission" to the main menu where you can check out the backstory and some in-game screenshots of Shutter 2! 

Thanks again for all your support, see you at Kent Island Prison!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/024ZvBV.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Steam Trading Card Set Now Available!
notes.content:
Thanks so much to everyone who has purchased Shutter!  Your support and feedback is helping us greatly to improve on Shutter and all our future titles.  

It’s very important for us to show our appreciation and provide as much value as we can to all of our customers. For this update we’ve decided to include the full set of Steam trading cards.  The set includes:

-	5 individual trading cards based on important characters and items from within the game   
-	5 standard badges and 1 rare foil badge
-	5 emoticons 
-	5 personalized hand painted backgrounds

We hope you enjoy them, and thanks again for your support!

notes.title: Version 1.10 Released
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who purchased Shutter, your feedback has been invaluable! We have been listening to your concerns, and have attempted to address many of them. We have done a full presentation update, and hope you enjoy the results.

[h1][u]List of Updates:[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*]Achievements added
[*]Graphical updates including new textures, normal maps, and specular shaders
[*]New sound effects
[*]Story updates
[*]Fixed bug which stuck player behind shed door
[*]Fixed bug where photographs after the last note were having issues
[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/PqOPTF1.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/1To8JE1.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wMZHONc.png[/img]
